sights.n: Senbonmatsu Ōhashi — the 'Megane-bashi' loop bridge (千本松大橋)
sights.address: over the Kizu River, linking Taishō-ku and Nishinari-ku, Osaka
sights.w: 1,228 m road bridge (1973) built 33 m above the Kizu River so ships can pass; the two-tier spiral approaches gave it the nickname 'Megane-bashi' (spectacles bridge), and the Taishō side is a three-level loop. Osaka City lists it as a landscape resource, best seen together with the free Senbonmatsu ferry below it.

sights.address: mouth of the Shirinashi River, linking Minato-ku and Taishō-ku, Osaka
sights.w: 1,573 m S-curved bridge (1995) over the mouth of the Shirinashi River. Its 250 m central span is Japan's largest for a girder bridge. You can walk across it in about 30 minutes, with a 360° harbour panorama that takes in the Chitose and Shin-Kizugawa bridges. Osaka City and Osaka Metro's Osaka Mania both feature it.
